relationships.subject: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy
relationships.evidence_quote: HBOT during the early phase of the SNC alleviates mechanical and thermal hypersensitivity and motor dysfunction.

relationships.subject: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy
relationships.evidence_quote: a significant reduction in the expression of MMP-9 in the spinal cord was noted in the SNC(HBOT) group compared to the SNC group

relationships.subject: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy
relationships.evidence_quote: the HBOT modulates the upregulation of Caspcase-3 activity, TRPV1 expression, and the colocalization of cleaved-Caspcase-3 with TRPV1 in the DRG compared to the untreated group

relationships.subject: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy
relationships.evidence_quote: the HBO treatment downregulates the elevated expression level of the TSPO

relationships.subject: sciatic nerve crush
relationships.evidence_quote: nerve crush promotes a significant increase in the expression of TRPV1 and Caspcase-3 at the transcription level in the sciatic nerve and DRG

key_findings: Early HBOT after sciatic nerve crush reduced allodynia, motor dysfunction, macrophage/microglia, MMP-9, TRPV1, TSPO and apoptosis in DRG and spinal cord
HBOT partly preserved spinal cord mitochondrial respiration after nerve injury
